title: Data-foundation quality comparison and diagnostic impact
comparison_scope: Current Ankara pack versus the implemented evidence contract with no external raster or building-height sidecar activated

absolute_roof_elevation_count.reason: no authoritative DTM with a compatible declared datum

path_level_impact.interpretation: No new source was activated, so the diagnostic contract reports the existing conservative height-aware states. The endpoint is separate from canonical RF dispatch.

controlled_fixtures.expected: median ground is stable; compatible roof = ground + AGL
min/median/max/spread are retained; spread above threshold marks base_elevation_uncertain
DSM is surface_only_not_ground; only explicit compatible DSM-DTM yields qualified nDSM evidence
selected precedence plus alternatives and review-required conflict
fallback_only; no absolute roof elevation without qualified ground and height evidence

canonical_output_policy.optimizer: unchanged; spatial evidence is not an objective or input
canonical_output_policy.four_i_reference_diagnostics: unchanged; spatial evidence only adds separate diagnostic endpoints

conclusion: The foundation is complete, but no coverage improvement is claimed. Promotion is blocked until a legal, datum-audited terrain source and/or a matched external height source produces a measured reduction in fallback-only evidence.
